scope: CPU thumbnail finite-batch service benchmark; 100 distinct inputs reused in nine measured trials

experiment.server_commit: not exposed by API; obtain from A separately
experiment.metric: validated outputs / client submit-to-result-download wall time
experiment.resource_window: server job created_at to finished_at; heartbeat samples, not process-only utilization

summary.metric: verified unique outputs / client submit-to-result-download wall time
summary.note: Finite-batch end-to-end service throughput, not bare-device peak throughput or proof of saturation.
resource_limitations: Heartbeat samples describe whole-device load, including other applications.
Missing GPU samples remain null; no GPU utilization is inferred.
The fixed workload may not saturate devices; inspect timings before claiming peak throughput.

checks: fixed source hashes and input budget
ZIP CRC and unique output inventory
manifest identity, counts, input mapping, output hashes
decoded PNG dimensions and exact reference pixels
single/pool placement and stable worker configurations at round boundaries
task and manifest consistency; all attempts equal one
timing arithmetic and full nine-round aggregation
heartbeat window filtering, deduplication and recorded summary consistency
limitations: Offline revalidation cannot reconstruct elapsed wall time independently of saved client timings.
Round-boundary snapshots do not rule out concurrent arrivals or configuration changes within a round.
Hashes identify retained local artifacts; raw payloads are not included in Git.

limits: Different Worker IDs still require B to confirm separate physical computers.
Exact PNG reference comparison assumes compatible Pillow resizing behavior; investigate version differences on mismatch.
This is a correctness smoke test, not a controlled throughput benchmark.
